subject: Request: Post-close entity & billing address update for Lynx Systems
messages:
From: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@lynx-systems.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lynx Systems Billing <billing@lynx-systems.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-close entity & billing address update

Hi Marcus,

Following our close last week, we need Redwood to issue future invoices to our new legal entity and shipping/billing address. Attached is the official entity change notice from our legal team (Lynx_Entity_Change_Notice.pdf). Key details below: 

- Current invoicing entity on file: Lynx Systems, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- New legal entity: Lynx & Co. Holdings, LLC (EIN: 98-7654321)
- Effective date for billing: 2026-06-01
- New billing address: 720 Harbor Point Dr., Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110
- VAT / tax id (EU subsidiary for shared services): GB999888777

We expect our accounts payable to route payments from the new entity starting with June invoices. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs a new W-9 or any additional paperwork to update billing? Also let us know if you require a final invoice to the old entity for receivables outstanding before 6/1.

Thanks — I copied our AP mailbox so they can supply attachments if needed.

Best,
Sofia Marin
Head of Finance Operations | Lynx Systems
sofia.marin@lynx-systems.com
Attachments: Lynx_Entity_Change_Notice.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@lynx-systems.com>
Cc: Lynx Systems Billing <billing@lynx-systems.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-close entity & billing address update

Hi Sofia — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the close.

Looping in Monica (finance) and Laura (legal) to advise on the exact artifacts we need and to coordinate the cutover. Quick answers up front:
- We can update the invoicing entity and send all future invoices to Lynx & Co. Holdings, LLC with the 6/1 effective date.
- Finance will need a signed W-9 (US entity) or equivalent tax form for non-US entities, and a copy of the entity change notice (which you attached).
- If you prefer, we can issue a final invoice to Lynx Systems, Inc. for any charges incurred prior to 6/1; let us know which open invoices to re-bill.

Monica — can you confirm the internal steps and whether we need a PO or change order on file for this migration?

Sofia — once we have the W-9 and confirmation on which invoices to reissue (if any), we’ll update billing in our system and send a confirmation message with the new invoice delivery details.

- Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@lynx-systems.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lynx Systems Billing <billing@lynx-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-close entity & billing address update

Hi Sofia — Monica from Redwood finance here. Thanks for the documentation; that helps a lot. Process and requests from our side: 

1) Required documents to update the billing entity in our ERP:
   - Signed W-9 for Lynx & Co. Holdings, LLC (US taxpayer). If the new paying entity is outside the US, please provide the appropriate W-8/W-9 equivalent and VAT registration certificate.
   - Copy of the entity change notice (we have the PDF you attached; thank you).
   - If there is a Purchase Order number the new entity will use for Redwood subscriptions, please share it so we can link the ledger.

2) Invoicing cutover options (choose one):
   a) Issue final invoice(s) to Lynx Systems, Inc. for any charges with a service period ending before 2026-06-01, then issue all new invoices to Lynx & Co. Holdings, LLC starting 2026-06-01.
   b) Re-bill outstanding invoices to the new entity (we can void & reissue). Note: re-billing requires authorization from the old entity/approver.

3) Payment method changes: If you are changing bank account or AP remittance information, include a copy of a voided check or bank letter.

I’ve created a DocuSign envelope for the W-9 to simplify this: https://docusign.com/txn/0a12b3c4d5 . If you’d rather email a signed PDF, attach it to a reply. Once received we will: update the legal/billing entity in our system, generate a confirmation email, and schedule the change to take effect on 2026-06-01.

Laura — from a contractual standpoint, do we need an internal amendment or is the entity mapping sufficient?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Financial Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: DocuSign link (W-9)
From: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@lynx-systems.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lynx Systems Billing <billing@lynx-systems.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 18:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-close entity & billing address update

Monica / Marcus — thanks for the clear checklist. Per your DocuSign link, I completed the W-9 and uploaded it (attached: signed_w9_lynx.pdf). We confirm option (a): please issue final invoice(s) to Lynx Systems, Inc. for any service periods ending before 2026-06-01, and send all new invoices to Lynx & Co. Holdings, LLC starting 6/1.

Banking / remittance will remain the same for now. Our AP team also provided the PO prefix the new entity will use: LYNX-HLD- (please map this).

Next steps requested from Redwood: 
- Confirm receipt of the signed W-9 and that you have updated the billing address and legal name in your system.
- Confirm whether any historical invoices need manual reissuance and the timeline for final invoices to be sent.

Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

Best,
Sofia Marin
Head of Finance Operations | Lynx Systems
Attachments: signed_w9_lynx.pdf
